verdict.rationale: RealtimeKit documents a first-party feature that generates an AI summary when a meeting ends, which is an AI-generated insight from the user's meeting data delivered inside the product. Managed transcription supports this. The Workers AI transcription and speech pipeline is a developer building block, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: AI suggestions or recommendations, insights beyond post-meeting summaries, depth of docs on summary content and configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Generate an AI summary when a meeting ends.
Add managed recording or transcription if your app needs it.
